question_text: A 25-year-old woman has dysuria, pyuria, increased frequency of urination, and fever of 1-day duration. She is sexually active. Urine cultures show gram-positive bacteria in clusters that are catalase-positive and coagulase-negative. The patient is started on trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole. Which of the following characteristics is used to identify the offending organism?

Which of the following characteristics is used to identify the offending organism?

opb. Resistance to bacitracin
opc. Sensitivity to novobiocin
opd. Sensitivity to bacitracin
ope. Resistance to novobiocin
